neh_ls_insertion.description: NEH constructive heuristic followed by single-pass insertion local search

arm_a_proposals.rationale: Start by processing jobs based on Palmer slope index in descending order. Then, select the first job that provides optimal C_max for the remaining schedule using flow time tie-breaking during insertion. Finally, apply single-pass insertion local search to polish the sequence.

First, we prioritize jobs by Palmer's slope index using the descending order of total processing time. This ensures that more critical jobs are processed earlier. Next, we construct a schedule using the makespan criterion, which evaluates partial schedules by minimizing C_max alone. During the construction process, we break ties between jobs with equal makespan by considering minimal flow time. To further refine our schedule, we apply single-pass insertion local search to polish it. This strategy allows us to improve the quality of the schedule while keeping the number of evaluations within the budget.

Optimize job order by prioritizing jobs with higher Palmer slope index (descending), then prioritize jobs with smaller flow times within each group of equal slope (ascending) during insertion, followed by single-pass insertion local search to refine the schedule.
